description: This file defines an abstract base class for a Drupal migration destination plugin related to entity display components, including methods for importing data, retrieving IDs, and managing entity display objects.

classes.name: ComponentEntityDisplayBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for migrating entity display components in Drupal, including methods for importing, getting IDs, and retrieving entity display objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity display repository and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class using a service container and configuration.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports data from a migration row, updating the entity's components based on the row data.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns an array defining the IDs used for migration, including entity type, bundle, mode, and field name.

methods.description: Placeholder method for defining fields; intentionally left empty.
